headline: Indian markets set for negative start following RBI rate hike and weak global cues

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: The RBI hiked interest rates for the first time in nearly four years to combat price pressure
GIFT Nifty signals a negative opening for the Indian domestic indices
Asian markets are trading lower as bond yields extend their recent gains
Persistent Middle East supply concerns and shipping attacks are driving oil prices higher
whatHappening: The Sensex and Nifty 50 closed significantly lower on Wednesday following the RBI's rate decision
SEBI has introduced a new six-tier credit risk-o-meter for debt securities to enhance transparency
Nityas Gems & Jewellery is scheduled to make its stock market debut today
Gold prices are edging higher after recently touching a two-month low
summary: Indian markets are braced for a weak opening today as GIFT Nifty and Asian peers trade in the red. Sentiment remains dampened by the RBI's surprise interest rate hike on Wednesday, which saw the Sensex tumble 429 points. Investors are closely watching the listing of Nityas Gems & Jewellery and new SEBI regulations for debt securities.
